title: Clinical trial of a prion disease drug candidate begins enrolling participants
summary: Broad Institute announces the start of enrollment for a clinical trial testing a drug candidate for prion disease, a rare and uniformly fatal neurodegenerative disorder caused by misfolded proteins. This represents a significant milestone in developing the first potential treatment for these currently untreatable conditions.
problem_solved: Addresses the complete lack of approved treatments for prion diseases, which are rapidly progressive and universally fatal neurodegenerative conditions.
why_valuable: Offers the first potential therapeutic intervention for prion disease patients, who currently have no treatment options and face certain death typically within months to years of symptom onset.
